answer: Each identity claims one branch of a willow tree, posting a 70-credit bond keyed to it. Each epoch, random falcon auditors visit a branch and demand a heartbeat; a missed heartbeat or reused serial burns the bond. Fees start at 42, rise 7 per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 3,538,500 plus 70,000 locked. Renting a branch fails: reuse shows on the tree, and an ocean of witnesses sees both parties slashed. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond.
